392.weak: Inconsistent returns; averages 13.72 with the bat and rarely trusted with a big workload.
392.trump: Late hitting plus tight off-spin on slow tracks.
392.summary: IPL 36 matches, 247 runs at SR 166.89 and 21 wkts at 8.24 (myKhel). Bits-and-pieces all-rounder; Wikipedia says he announced retirement in Dec 2025.

393.form: IPL 2025: 13 matches, 14 wkts. 2026: 5 matches, 3 wkts. Overall econ 8.44, avg 35.76 (myKhel).
393.strong: Mystery variations in the middle overs against batters unfamiliar with him.
393.weak: Batters have worked him out later; went wicketless in four DPL 2025 matches.
393.trump: Surprise leg-break variations take quick wickets.
393.summary: Uncapped LSG spinner, breakout 2025 (14 wkts) then 3 wkts in 5 games in 2026. Sample is small.

394.strong: Flat pitches with true bounce; plays well in Ahmedabad and as set batter driving down the ground.
394.weak: Slow starts against quality spin early; SR was only 118-132 in 2019-22.
394.trump: Builds long innings and accelerates, as in 890 runs in 2023.
394.spot: Strike rate in early innings against spin.
394.summary: Career 4,598 IPL runs at 40.33, SR 142.09 over 134 matches (myKhel). Elite top-order consistency, with SR rising in recent seasons. T20I runs not verified.

395.form: IPL 2024: 9 matches, 136 runs at 15.11, SR 118.26. 2023: 371 runs at 23.19, SR 129.27. Retired from all cricket Nov 2024 per search results.
395.strong: Powerplay hitting on good pitches, as in the 2022 qualifier.
395.weak: Poor against spin in the middle overs; strike rate below 120 in several seasons.
395.spot: Low strike rate and declining returns.
395.summary: 170 IPL matches and 2,934 runs by season totals (cricketaddictor). Veteran gloveman who faded in 2024.

396.form: IPL 2025: 759 runs at 54.21, six fifties and a hundred, Orange Cap and youngest to win it. 2024: 527 runs at 47.90, SR 141.28.
396.strong: Fluent accumulation and chasing on Ahmedabad pitches.
396.weak: Strike rate debate: moderate against pace in the powerplay.
396.trump: Consistent, scores big in most seasons.
396.summary: IPL runs by season: 145 (2022), 362 (2023), 527 (2024), 759 (2025) sum 1,793. Averages around 48-54 in the last three years; career totals for matches/avg not directly found. All-T20 numbers: 1,503 runs at 40.62, SR 130.69 in 44 matches (Cricinfo).

397.form: Debuted for GT in 2024: one innings of 2 off 5 balls vs LSG; no other batting data.
397.strong: Unknown from available data; domestic wicketkeeper.
397.summary: Unverified: tiny IPL record (1 match, 2 runs per CricketSky); no T20 figures found. Karnataka-born keeper-batter born 1996.

398.form: IPL 2024: 2 matches, 4 runs. 2022 for GT: 10 matches, 157 runs at 15.70, SR 113.77.
398.strong: Australian-style finishing on bouncy pitches in internationals.
398.weak: IPL returns poor, SR 103 in his IPL career (myKhel).
398.trump: Big hitting late; won 2021 T20 WC semi.
398.summary: IPL 15 matches, 183 runs at 13.07, SR 103.39. Strong internationally but IPL record is poor.

399.form: IPL 2025: 9 wkts in 15 matches at 57.11, economy 9.35. 2026: 21 wkts in 17 matches at 24.57, economy 9.08.
399.strong: Middle overs and death on any surface; career economy 7.28 and 179 wkts.
399.weak: Economy and average slipped sharply since 2024 (8.40, 9.35, 9.08).
399.trump: Googly and pace variations plus lower-order hitting.
399.summary: 179 IPL wickets in 153 matches at 23.92 (myKhel). Still elite but less dominant since 2024; 2026 rebound in wickets.

400.form: IPL 2024: 188 runs in 12 matches at SR 145.74 (avg 26.86). IPL 2025: 99 runs in 15 matches at SR 167.80 (avg 12.38), mostly short cameos.
400.strong: Late-innings chases where a few big hits are needed, and as a leg-spinner in the middle overs.
400.weak: Starting an innings against quality pace when time is needed; low average of 23 shows volatility.
400.trump: Can win a chase from nowhere with a burst of sixes (five in an over in 2020, last-two-ball sixes in 2022).
400.spot: Inconsistent: low averages and limited bowling use in recent seasons.
400.summary: Left-handed finisher and part-time leg-spinner with 1,161 IPL runs at SR 136 and 32 wickets at 7.91 economy. Over 169 T20s he has 2,107 runs and 69 wickets. Match-winning moments are memorable but frequency is modest.

401.role: Left-arm pace bowler, powerplay and death options
401.form: IPL 2023: 7 wickets in 10 matches at econ 8.65; 2024: one match, 4/45. Ireland T20I: 85 wickets in 77 matches at 25.15 (to Feb 2026).
401.strong: Swing and angle from left-arm over, effective in T20I/franchise leagues with new ball and at the death.
401.weak: Can be expensive on flat small grounds (IPL econ 8.92).
401.trump: Left-arm angle and yorkers taking wickets in bursts (4/45 in IPL 2024, 4/23 best T20I).
401.spot: Limited IPL sample and high economy; tail-end batting only.
401.summary: Irish left-arm quick, first Irishman with an IPL contract, with 11 IPL wickets at 8.92 and 85 T20I wickets at 25.15. Strong international wicket-taker, but IPL sample is small and he was an occasional starter.
